acceptance_policy.basis: Established after three-mesh results. P2 velocity/P1 pressure on quadratic geometry show decreasing errors. Absolute acceptance is 0.01 percent for relative L2/pressure/lambda, much smaller than the formal finite-pipe end effect; also require at least 3-fold coarse-to-fine decrease. No 10/20 percent relaxation.
acceptance_policy.natural_mode_analytic_difference: Model end effect, not an analytic hard gate under explicit user clarification
